draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.22, the 81st-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 14th of 36 at CB. He went 42nd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (81st): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Deandre Baker. Testing standouts: three-cone (95th percentile). Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (1st percentile). College production: 8 passes defended in 2023, 9th of 34 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Houston Texans. 30 career games and 30 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (9 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: passes defended 17 (97th percentile), interceptions 4 (96th percentile), approximate value 9 (96th percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 cornerback who played: 92.2% season snap share against a median of 27.8%, above the norm.
